final: STATUS: fail SUMMARY: The site holds up in the browser: no external requests, contrast and focus rings pass, no horizontal scroll at 320/360/1280, and the genre filter, events timezones and form validation all behave. One reproduced blocker: with JavaScript off, a valid contact-form submit gives no demo notice and no mailto, and puts the message into the URL. Rest is minor. FILES TOUCHED: none (scratch probes in /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-mv-e9x3f-workspace/c64675ad-fb1b-4e3e-befa-7d8c152cb78c/scratchpad/; `git status` unchanged, 13 added files) FINDINGS: - [blocking] No-JS form path (checklist: "says plainly that it's a demo"). `javaScriptEnabled:false`, fill name/email/message, click Send → URL becomes `/visit.html?name=Ada&email=ada%40example.com&subject=&message=Secret+note+about+a+book`, `#form-status` empty, `#mailto-wrap` hidden. The form has no action, so the message goes into the URL and nothing says it was not sent. Whether no-JS is in scope is the orchestrator's call. - [minor] No-JS pages render empty: home lists, the books catalogue and the events list are all empty with no explanation. The events empty-note is `hidden` by default, so the JS-off events page is blank. - [minor] Menu button is inert without JS, and the nav stays visible below 720px. - [minor] At 200% text size (`html{font-size:200%}`), visit.html scrolls: scrollWidth 363 at viewport 360 and at 320. Cause: `.hours-table td{white-space:nowrap}`. Not reproduced at default text size. - [minor] Stale mailto: after a demo submit, editing the message and not resubmitting leaves `#mailto-link` with the old text while the demo status stays (`STALE mailto still says first: true`). - [minor] Double submit sets identical status text, so a screen reader may not re-announce it (reasoning only, not reproduced with AT). - [minor] Books copy "Every title here is on our shelves or can be ordered in within three working days" is not backed by the data. - [minor] "Upcoming" is day-granular, so a 19:00 event stays listed after it starts (within the criteria, worth knowing). - [minor] Simplicity: `Marginalia.makeElement` and `todayIso` are exported but used only inside site.js. - [minor] Tests gap: run.mjs asserts focus-ring contrast but no body-text contrast, no 320px width, and no no-JS path. `form-html-in-fields-is-text-only` is weak: the message is never rendered anyway, so its `` check passes trivially. The local-midnight and timezone test is behavioural and real. - [minor] Long mailto href (5183 chars for a 5000-char message) may truncate in some mail clients (not reproduced). CHECKS: - Network, 4 pages, all requests recorded in Chromium → 0 external (pass) - Contrast, every visible text node plus input/chip borders and button text, at 1280 and 360 → all ≥ AA (pass) - Tab through each page at 1280/360/320 (menu opened at narrow widths) → every stop has a solid ≥2px outline, skip link first (pass) - scrollWidth at 320/360/1280, default and menu open → ≤ width (pass) - Books, 15 hostile `?genre=` values (unknown, empty, MYSTERY, `Science+Fiction`, `%20`, `
